rule: Alpha is the centered content-logit RMS of the trained P-L encoder divided by the centered (t_j - mu_i)^2 RMS. Both are measured on eight training batches, both masked views, and all three cross-attention blocks. Per-query means are removed first because softmax ignores a constant on a query. The seed-42 initialization's own centered content RMS is recorded and is not the scale: those logits sit far below one, so matching them leaves the softmax nearly unchanged. The locked value is then applied to that initialization, and the run starts only if the attention distribution moves. There is no eight-step loss sweep, and the value is not changed after the check.
